## Close C1 {#closing minutes=0 kind=closing}

::: point {#C1.a band=Basic}

::: proof

::: proof

:::

:::

:::

::: to-get-there {level=redo}
WHERE-REDO: derive a number on your project.
:::
:::

::: point {#C1.e band=Outstanding}
LIMIT-STATEMENT: where the design stops holding.

::: proof
LIMIT-PROOF: the limit, written down.
:::

::: to-get-there {level=not-yet}

:::

:::

::: to-get-there {level=redo}
